# The Xenia shaders the renderer embeds as precompiled DXBC (Shader Model 5.1), one source per line,
# relative to the Xenia root. cmake/xenia_shaders.cmake compiles each with the Windows SDK's fxc.exe
# into <build>/generated/xenia-shaders/xenia/<gpu|ui>/shaders/bytecode/d3d12_5_1/<name>_<stage>.h,
# the header Xenia's own build makes (tools/build/compile_shader_dxbc.py). tools/vendor_xenia_shaders.py
# copies these sources and everything they include into this directory.
#
# EDRAM resolves (gfx/d3d12_pm4_shmem.cpp; the emulation layer's resolve path, kept for the test oracle)
src/xenia/gpu/shaders/resolve_fast_32bpp_1x2xmsaa.cs.xesl
src/xenia/gpu/shaders/resolve_fast_32bpp_4xmsaa.cs.xesl
